tools.name: inspect_product_evidence
tools.description: Read the active product question, claim-specific sources, citations, rights, answer, open filming mission, privacy receipt, and valid next action. Use on arrival and after evidence changes.

tools.name: ask_product_question
tools.description: Open or replace the active case with one public product name, optional product-page URL, and observable question. The schema cannot receive identity, budget, history, or private preferences.

productName.description: Public product name or model label; do not include buyer context.

productUrl.description: Optional public HTTP or HTTPS product-page URL.

question.description: One concrete product question that observable evidence could answer.

tools.name: refine_filming_mission
tools.description: Replace the open mission’s recording instruction and acceptance boundary before any contributor link exists. Preserve the question and fresh-capture challenge; use the exact inspected revision so stale agent state cannot overwrite a newer mission.

instruction.description: Exactly what a person with the product should record.

successCriterion.description: What must stay visible or audible for the result to be useful.

minimumSeconds.description: Minimum continuous observation length in seconds.

continuousTakeRequired.description: Whether cuts would weaken what this evidence can establish.

expectedRevision.description: Exact revision returned by inspect_product_evidence; prevents replacing a mission that changed after inspection.
